title: Purity improvement and efficient recovery of levoglucosan mist produced by fast pyrolysis of cellulose using corona discharge
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14876-14880
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01634G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Takashi Nomura, Eiji Minami, Haruo Kawamoto
This study describes the in situ separation of levoglucosan from aldehyde by-products (fermentation inhibitors) in pyrolysis-based saccharification of cellulosic biomass for the production of bioplastics and biofuels.
